description: This file defines the AzureQueueBatchContainerV2 class, which implements the IBatchContainer interface for Azure Queue streaming in Orleans. It supports external serializers like JSON, manages stream events, request context, and sequence tokens.

classes.name: AzureQueueBatchContainerV2
classes.description: A batch container for Azure Queue streaming that supports external serialization and manages stream events and request context.
